# dodopayments_product_collections (Data Source)

Lists product collections.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dodopayments_product_collections" "example" {
  max_items = 10
}

output "product_collections" {
  value = data.dodopayments_product_collections.example.items
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `archived` (Boolean) List archived collections.
- `brand_id` (String) Filter by Brand id.
- `max_items` (Number) The maximum number of items to return. The default is 1000.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The product collections that the API returned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when created.
- `description` (String) Collection description.
- `id` (String) Collection ID.
- `name` (String) Collection name.
- `products_count` (Number) Number of products in the collection.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when last updated.
